Definition_and_Baseline: Common grounded raster domain (866,358 cells, 216,062.17 km²). Baseline: 133,497.59 km³ (Bedmap3) / 140,702.51 km³ (BedMachine).
Permitted_Usage_in_Phase_5_2: Authoritative anchor for observational volume and physical backbone mass conservation testing.
Strictly_Prohibited_Usage: Direct addition of ISMIP6 sector VAF anomalies; conflation with raw vector catchment (232,678.32 km²).

Component_or_Quantity: Basin Grounded Ice Volumes (Hp-I, I-Ipp, Ipp-J)
Definition_and_Baseline: Approved grounded raster areas (108,945.63, 49,757.73, 57,358.82 km²). Baselines: Bedmap3 (100,120.11, 11,079.71, 22,297.77 km³).
Permitted_Usage_in_Phase_5_2: Spatial bounds for physical flowline boundary-layer geometry and mass continuity balance.
Strictly_Prohibited_Usage: Treating ISMIP6 Sectors 16, 17, 18 as exact 1:1 basin equivalents without spatial proxy disclaimer.

Definition_and_Baseline: Seroussi et al. 2020 multi-model scalar projections (Zenodo 3940766). N=16 models, 155 experiments.
Permitted_Usage_in_Phase_5_2: External independent comparison benchmark; qualitative scientific interpretation; ingestion interface design.
Strictly_Prohibited_Usage: Tuning, fitting, or calibrating Pillar 1 parameters (D_0, h_GL,0, gamma, beta, theta_buttress) using ISMIP6 outputs.

Component_or_Quantity: ISMIP6 Ice Volume Above Flotation (ivaf / VAF)
Definition_and_Baseline: Integrated column exceeding flotation threshold. Dimension L³. Anomaly Delta VAF(2015) = 0.
Permitted_Usage_in_Phase_5_2: Independent benchmark metric for sea-level potential comparison.
Strictly_Prohibited_Usage: Direct addition to grounded baseline; relabeling VAF as total grounded ice-equivalent volume.

Definition_and_Baseline: 1D flowline dynamic backbone: Schoof (2007) flux, buttressing factor theta in [0,1], firn air depletion.
Permitted_Usage_in_Phase_5_2: Implementation of governing equations, dimensional consistency, mass conservation tests, observational range sweeps.
Strictly_Prohibited_Usage: Calibration against ISMIP6 outputs; final observational parameter calibration before sign-off.

Definition_and_Baseline: Phase 3.2 historical reconstruction (1979–2024), BedMachine V4.1 topography, ITS_LIVE InSAR surface velocities.
Permitted_Usage_in_Phase_5_2: Independent boundary condition extraction, physical parameter range definitions.
Strictly_Prohibited_Usage: Mixing simulation outputs into calibration priors; tuning against Phase 4C held-out test set.

Definition_and_Baseline: Zero-mean prior, hard magnitude ceiling <= 0.25 D_physics, non-negative discharge barrier.
Permitted_Usage_in_Phase_5_2: Design and mathematical formulation of Stage 2 residual architecture.
Strictly_Prohibited_Usage: Residual model training, feature selection, or coupling to physical backbone during Phase 5.2.
